source: Existing model constructors + approved practical specifications; generated by npm run audit:labs
policy: Core intended practical routes, not zero-apparatus supplied review examples. Optional apparatus does not gate access. Individual reagent bottles and instrument leads can be bundled with supplies/equipment; see definitions.

uncertainties: Second filtration and fresh paper are optional under the owner-approved beaker endpoint.

experiments.name: Solution preparation & dilution
experiments.units: See original model for mL, mol, grams and instrument units
assemblies: Boat or beaker on balance; stoppered flasks for mixing; pipette for the measured aliquot.
experiments.safetyNote: No runtime safety/PPE unlock is implemented. Existing wrong actions remain possible; this is not a real-lab safety approval.
uncertainties: The model accepts direct transfer into the flask. The small funnel is recommended, not an artificial unlock gate. Balance/boat support the explicitly approved weighing objective although review examples can be answered without it.

experiments.name: Acid–base titration
experiments.units: See original model for mL, mol, grams and instrument units

uncertainties: Indicators are included with supplies; the optional pH probe is not needed for an indicator-based route. Funnel filling is recommended but not enforced by the existing model.

experiments.name: Reaction rates
experiments.units: See original model for mL, mol, grams and instrument units
assemblies: Clamp the syringe; connect bung/tube. Acid can be added directly; inner vial gives a controlled combined mixing/clock start.
experiments.safetyNote: No runtime safety/PPE unlock is implemented. Existing wrong actions remain possible; this is not a real-lab safety approval.
uncertainties: Direct solid-bottle portions and direct acid mixing exist in code, so spatula/vial are recommended, not unlock requirements. In-lab fresh-trial resets are covered by one activity-supply reservation.

experiments.name: Conductivity
experiments.units: See original model for mL, mol, grams and instrument units
assemblies: Two probe tips contact one sample; connect separate leads. Water/waste allow rinsing.
experiments.safetyNote: No runtime safety/PPE unlock is implemented. Existing wrong actions remain possible; this is not a real-lab safety approval.
uncertainties: A single reading can be made with one sample, but the four-solution comparison and clean rinsing route needs six vessels. Extra mixing/dry-solid beakers are optional extensions.

experiments.name: Colorimetry
experiments.units: See original model for mL, mol, grams and instrument units
assemblies: Filled cuvette seated in instrument; blank and measure at a consistent filter with lid/face conditions recorded.
experiments.safetyNote: No runtime safety/PPE unlock is implemented. Existing wrong actions remain possible; this is not a real-lab safety approval.
uncertainties: The fit needs three distinct concentrations, including a valid zero solvent point; four non-zero standard vessels are not mandatory. Assisted metered portions are the current implementation.

experiments.name: Zinc–copper voltaic cell
experiments.units: See original model for mL, mol, grams and instrument units
assemblies: Zinc and copper in corresponding solutions; both salt-bridge legs wet; lead connections and optional load.
providedFacilities: Leads and 100 Ω load bundled with the meter
experiments.safetyNote: No runtime safety/PPE unlock is implemented. Existing wrong actions remain possible; this is not a real-lab safety approval.
uncertainties: Zinc is consumed and copper changes by redox, so supplied strips are consumables. Bridge tube stays owned; its KNO₃ gel is a separate supply.
